name: counterTargetSpell
signature: export function counterTargetSpell(effect: Extract<Effect, { do: 'counter' }>, ctx: AbilityContext, env: PrimitiveEnv): PrimitiveResult
rules: CR 608.2b a spell whose targets are all illegal does not resolve
contract: Reads the announced stack target through P18 and emits COUNTER_SPELL with that stackId.
A target that is no longer on the stack emits nothing and defers once, saying the target had already left. It must not counter a different object.
No announced stack target at all defers once; it never guesses at the top of the stack.
Emits at most one COUNTER_SPELL per announced target.

evidence.claim: countering is delegated to the stack, keyed on the announced target id

assertions.given: Counterspell with a live stack target
the target already gone from the stack
assertions.expect: zero actions, one deferred, and no COUNTER_SPELL aimed anywhere else
